links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to spinal cord injury questions (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: Readability of all four LLMs was generally low, requiring college-level reading comprehension, though they could effectively simplify complex content when prompted.
links.quote: Although the readability of all four LLMs was generally low, requiring a college-level reading comprehension ability, they were all able to effectively simplify complex content.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM answers to SCI questions rated by three spine surgeons
links.effect: 'Good' accuracy ratings: ChatGPT 83.8%, Claude 78.4%, Gemini 54.1%, Llama 62.2%.
links.quote: Notably, ChatGPT led in accuracy, achieving significantly higher "Good" ratings (83.8%) compared to Claude (78.4%), Gemini (54.1%), and Llama (62.2%).

unlisted_practices: Prompting LLMs to revise their own responses (self-correction) to improve accuracy

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates multiple LLMs for patient education in spinal cord injury and specifically tests the effect of prompting for revision/self-correction on output accuracy.
